assistant.heading: Your assistant
assistant.description: Name, avatar and personality are used everywhere in the app and in how the assistant replies. Private to you: stored on this computer and follows your GitHub account when signed in (kept across computers). Teammates — managers included — can't see it and have their own assistant.
assistant.name: Assistant name
assistant.customPlaceholder: e.g. like an encouraging older sibling who jokes a little

claude.heading: AI connection
claude.description: Choose how the assistant runs. Everyone uses their own account or key.

support.heading: Support
support.description: Hit a bug? Send a report with the app version and recent log (personal info masked) so the team can fix it.

claude-cli.name: Claude Code CLI (recommended)
claude-cli.description: Uses your Claude Pro/Max plan through Claude Code signed in on this computer.

anthropic-api.name: Anthropic API key (fallback)
anthropic-api.description: Uses an API key you create on Claude Console; usage is billed to your own account.

ai.invalidKey: Invalid key format (should start with sk-ant-).
ai.noSecureStorage: This computer has no secure storage, so the API key cannot be saved.
ai.keyHelp: The key is encrypted, stays on this computer, and is only ever sent to Anthropic.
ai.getKey: Create a key on Claude Console
ai.autoSuggestHelp: When you leave a chat with 2+ new messages, the assistant suggests what to remember (uses one extra AI call). You still review before saving.

update.heading: Updates
update.description: The app downloads new versions from the team's GitHub Releases. Chat history and settings are always kept.
update.autoCheckHelp: On launch and every 2 hours. When off, only when you click "Check now".

beta.name: Beta
beta.description: Also receive pre-releases to try new features — may contain bugs.

status.unsupported: This build does not support auto-update (dev or local build).

experimental.heading: Experimental features
experimental.description: New features, off by default. Only enable them after reading the instructions.
experimental.agents: Agent connections (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, MCP)

skills.heading: Skills
skills.description: Teach {{name}} your own way of working with skills (a folder with SKILL.md, like Claude skills). {{name}} picks a few skills that fit each question instead of using all of them. Skills are text only — the app never runs bundled scripts.
skills.howToCall: Call one by name in chat: "use skill <name>" or "/<name>".

preview.title: Install skill "{{name}}"?
preview.replaces: A skill with this name exists — installing replaces it.
preview.skipped: Skipped (scripts, binary or oversized files — not installed, never run)
preview.textOnly: Read the content before installing: the skill is added to the assistant instructions whenever it is picked.

style.heading: Your style (my-style)
style.description: Notes on how you like answers, slides, documents and code. Always used when present. Only what you approve is saved.
style.proposed: Suggestions — untick or edit before saving
style.nothing: Nothing new about your style yet.
style.error: Could not learn right now. Try again later.
style.addPlaceholder: Add a note yourself, e.g. Dark slides, large text

errors.no_skill_md: No SKILL.md found in the package.
errors.many_skill_md: The package has several SKILL.md files — install one skill at a time.
errors.bad_frontmatter: SKILL.md needs a frontmatter with name and description.
errors.bad_name: Skill names may only contain lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
errors.builtin_name: Same name as a built-in app skill — rename the skill.
errors.bad_zip: The .zip file is broken or unreadable.
errors.unreadable: Could not read the selected folder / file.
errors.install: Install failed. Try picking the package again.
